meta.notes: An empty flower pot (type flower_pot) that takes dandelion, poppy, allium, cornflower, oak sapling, birch sapling: use it with one of them to put the plant in, and it becomes the generated potted block msm_examples:clay_planter_<plant> (for example msm_examples:clay_planter_dandelion). Use a potted pot with an empty hand to take the plant out; breaking it drops the pot and the plant. Other plants do not go in, and vanilla's own flower pot is not changed. Its clay is drawn by MSM; the earth is vanilla's dirt and the item picture vanilla's pot.
